title: The Cleansing Wave
lyrics: [D]Oh now I see the [G]crimson wave, The [D]fountain deep and [A]wide;
[D]Jesus, my Lord, [G]mighty to save, Points [D]to His [A7]wounded [D]side.
[D]The [G]cleansing stream I [D]see, I see, I [A]plunge, and [A7]O, it [G]cleanseth [D]me!
[D]O [G]praise the Lord! it [D]cleanseth me, It [A]cleanseth me, [A7]yes, cleanseth [D]me.
I see the new creation rise,
I rise to walk in heaven's own light,
With heart made pure and garments white,
